themes_detail.label: Tree Infrastructure Crisis
themes_detail.summary: East Flatbush experienced a dramatic surge in tree-related complaints this week, with 15 damaged tree reports (up 823% from 1.6 weekly average) and 6 dead/dying tree reports (up 2300% from 0.2 weekly average), suggesting either acute weather damage, disease outbreak, or delayed maintenance backlog now surfacing.
evidence: Damaged Tree complaints: 15 last week vs. 1.6 weekly baseline (z-score: 19.22, 823% increase)
Dead/Dying Tree complaints: 6 last week vs. 0.2 weekly baseline (z-score: 13.28, 2300% increase)
Combined tree-related 311 complaints indicate concentrated infrastructure stress in single week
reporting_angles: Interview Parks Department about tree health assessment and emergency removal capacity in East Flatbush
Investigate whether recent weather events (storms, freeze-thaw cycles) triggered accelerated tree failure

themes_detail.label: Illegal Dumping Spike
themes_detail.summary: Illegal dumping complaints in East Flatbush jumped 124% this week to 14 reports compared to a 6.2 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks, signaling either coordinated dumping activity or breakdown in enforcement and monitoring.
evidence: Illegal Dumping: 14 complaints this week vs. 6.2 weekly average (z-score: 5.57, 124% increase)
Spike occurred this week, breaking multi-week baseline pattern
Geographic concentration suggests potential single source or corridor problem
reporting_angles: Map dumping hotspots and investigate whether they correlate with reduced DSNY enforcement patrols
Interview residents about whether they've witnessed repeat dumping activity or heard of organized waste disposal

themes_detail.label: Street Sweeping Deterioration
themes_detail.summary: Street sweeping complaints in East Flatbush surged 823% this week with 15 reports versus a 1.6 weekly average, mirroring the tree damage spike and suggesting either coordinated environmental degradation or systemic municipal service failure.
evidence: Street Sweeping Complaint: 15 complaints this week vs. 1.6 weekly baseline (z-score: 5.47, 823% increase)
Temporal alignment with tree debris spike suggests fallen branches may be overwhelming street cleaning capacity
Spike is concentrated in current week only
reporting_angles: Confirm whether street sweeping complaints are tied to tree damage debris overwhelming municipal cleanup resources
Contact DSNY about staffing and equipment allocation to East Flatbush this week

themes_detail.label: Commercial Disposal Problem
themes_detail.summary: Commercial disposal complaints spiked dramatically 2 weeks ago with 4 reports against a near-zero 0.1 weekly average (3100% increase), indicating possible new commercial activity or waste contractor issues in the district.
evidence: Commercial Disposal Complaint: 4 complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.1 weekly baseline (z-score: 11.72, 3100% increase)
Spike is 2 weeks old, predating current week's environmental pattern
Extreme baseline volatility (near-zero average) suggests new commercial entity or contractor
reporting_angles: Identify which commercial entity or waste contractor triggered complaints 2 weeks ago
Check whether disposal permit violations or CEQB violations were filed

themes_detail.label: Electrical Hazards Emerging
themes_detail.summary: Electrical complaints in East Flatbush spiked 2 weeks ago with 3 reports versus a 0.1 weekly average (2300% increase, z-score 8.69), a rare category that may indicate infrastructure failures or new electrical hazards requiring urgent investigation.
evidence: Electrical complaints: 3 complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.1 weekly baseline (z-score: 8.69, 2300% increase)
Electrical complaints are rare baseline category, making spike statistically notable
Spike is 2 weeks old; no follow-up data on current week indicates whether issue resolved or ongoing
reporting_angles: Request Con Edison incident reports and work orders for East Flatbush from past 2 weeks
Interview affected residents about nature of electrical hazards (downed lines, exposed wiring, transformer issues)
